description: This is a wide, newly paved two-lane road with smooth asphalt and clear lane markings, but there is no visible sidewalk directly along the roadway; instead, a separate light-colored paved path runs on the right, divided from traffic by a grassy strip rather than a physical barrier. The corridor has frequent streetlights and some low greenery, but little tree canopy or shade, and there are no visible crosswalks, curb ramps, or other accessibility features; the open road geometry may encourage moderate to higher vehicle speeds.
